notes.title: v4.5.1 Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
Damage calculations are now rounded up to avoid possible edge cases, when enemy could be hit the same way with the same weapon and once every 50 tests it would not die due to how floats operate
Narrations about location now respects the “character lines frequency” option in the Settings menu

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Fixed an issue with Delifers realising Hellbats even when they weren’t killed by a headshot
Fixed an issue of black screen appearing after dying on the Chapter 1 Boss arena 
Fixed an issue of invisible cursor if player died from lethal fall damage in Ironman mode
Bunch of improvements to the Brazilian translation
Fixed a menacing barrel standing in the Fort area of Chapter 2 without its metal belt. Scary!

notes.title: Blood West 4.4.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Changes:
- Fixed an issue where player was unable to properly respawn after death
- Fixed reward for the Drinking Buddies quest not spawning at correct location
- Fixed an edge case where Spirits being target of the Cleansing Fire quest would despawn if player ran away and slept
- Fixed a rare case of the door leading to the Chapter 1 boss remaining closed after opening it once, if it happened between versions
- Fixed a buzzing sound that occurred near enemies killed by projectile weapons
- Fixed an issue where Jim could repeat the quest dialogue for Family Ties after the target was already killed
- Fixed an issue where Horned Shadow would not end the questline with proper dialogue
- Fixed lack of voice over for one of Bristle Mike’s lines
- Fixed a potential issue for saves in which players have already given Jim the coin, which could block players from receiving the new quest 
- Fixed an issue where maxed out High Tolerance perk would not correctly prolong the positive buffs of alcohol
- Fixed a potential stuck point in the well in Chapter 1
- Fixed a few typos
- Improved clarity of texts indicating that non-story achievements are not enabled in Story and Custom difficulties
- Improved some Cactus Bota animations
- The Blur weapon no longer is locked until death (may require using Purple Revival once to take it off for players already having it equipped)
- Small improvements to certain ragdolls - this should help with cases of extreme enemy ragdolling 
- Added the respec potion (New Dawn Tincture) to the shops at Chapter 1 for New Game+. Also added this potion to shops in Chapter 2 for every kind of game, so it’s available earlier.

notes.title: Patch 4.1.0 for Blood West & Dead Man's Promise
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Version: 4.1.0[/b] 

[i]Patch #1 for Dead Man’s Promise and patch #6 for base game[/i] [/h3]

[quote][b]For those affected by the issue with an empty map (no enemies, no NPCs): simply rest in bed. A single rest should fix this and populate the map again! If your player character is wearing the Ring of Tahoe, unequip it before resting![/b][/quote]
[u][b]Bug fixes:
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where using [b]ALT+F4[/b] during player’s death could result in enemies and NPCs missing from map
[*] Fixed an issue where it was impossible to activate the altar at the bottom of the Mine and open portal leading to end-game
[*] Fixed cases where every ammo stack had only one bullet (including traders)
[*] Fixed a bug where Herald Talisman and Devil’s Eye buffs would reset after saving and loading a game
[*] Fixed a bug where melee attacks would not register correctly when using a staff
[*] Fixed an issue where Strix would ignore rocks being thrown at them
[*] Fixed a case where a Terror Eye could be performing ranged attacks on an entity other than the player and that attack would still affect the player
[*] Fixed a bug in which Nightmare’s SFX could stack and overlap aggressively if it couldn’t reach the player
[*] Fixed a case of cursed cave where Rotten Skeleton resides - the layout of objects inside it should no longer change 
[*] Fixed certain dialogues missing their voiceover or their VO was truncated
[*] Fixed an issue where Coffin Amulet wouldn’t always stun a Skin Collector
[*] Fixed an issue where The Untouchables values in their description were incorrect
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies would stop moving due to specific circumstances
[*] Fixed an issue where a projectile like a Tomahawk would disappear after hitting an ethereal enemy like a Spirit
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to use the Music Box an unlimited amount of times by triggering a keybind
[*] Fixed few issues with the Hungarian translation
[/list]
[u][b]Improvements:
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Staff of the Vengeful Raven projectiles are a bit more centered and less prone to going to the right
[*] Strix will not move super close to the player and thus avoid certain undesired behaviours
[*] Shambler (the chest aka player’s stash) will no longer have its SFX overlap. Also, it will stay still when being used
[*] Few improvements to the Vessel enemy type that will make them slightly better at aiming and hitting the player at a distance and will not lose aggro so easily
[*] Added a few more firearms to certain areas of the Dead Man’s Promise map to help smoothen the gameplay for players exploring areas on their own
[*] Items lying on the ground will no longer risk getting kicked from the map by enemies (this will make it impossible for items like Coin Necklace or Living Vines to fall from the map)
[*] Small improvements to VO of the Shaman when passing portals
[*] Pain Threshold - extra damage nerfed from 10% to 5%
[*] A few improvements to controller support
[*] Additional artwork has been added to Dead Man’s Promise loading screens!
[*] Saber heavy attack is now a stab (also in base game)
[*] Dead Man’s Promise’s map should load much faster now!
[*] A slew of extra SFX improvements
[*] Small update to the credits and miniscule update to texts in general
[/list]
Thank you for your patience as we worked on the first patch for Dead Man's Promise! If you've enjoyed Blood West, Dead Man's Promise and the Shaman's journey - don't forget to leave a review, Gunslinger!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158590/Blood_West_Dead_Mans_Promise/

[b]Version: 3.3.0 (post-release patch #4) [/b]
[u]Date 05.12.2024[/u]

[b]Quality of Life improvements and new features:[/b]
[list]
[*]The List of saved games now displays a thumbnail to help figure out which save is which and where, especially useful when having a lots of different saves (applies to every new save)
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/fee6d898e6195b6fe3bfff55b56c84508f078915.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/d1295a6d5a5d4c22a34d172e4af29a7f0bc3d601.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the scrollbars were not visible in certain menus[/list]

notes.title: Version: 3.2.2 (hotfix #2 for patch #3)
notes.notes:
Changes:
We’ve heard you and we’ve nerfed enemy detection ranges across the board to get them more in line with old values. No more enemy spotting you across two compounds. Or that pesky Spirit noticing player from across the map. We will continue to monitor your response and adjust this in the future if needed. 

Bug fix:
Fixed few more issues with 21:9 aspect ratio

notes.title: Version: 3.2.1 (hotfix for patch #3)
notes.notes:
[h3]
Bug fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed the sorting items bug that could cause items to disappear under specific conditions - this time for good!
[*] HUD will display properly when using 21:9 aspect ratio. 
[*] Fixed missing sliders in the Journal and inventory screens. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the sensitivity option was not changed when the player changed the input device.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “unstuck ammo” function sometimes produces a wrong SFX.
[*] Fixed an issue where two Boo Hags could appear after saving & loading the game when her quest was completed.
[*] Fixed an issue where using a Raven Skull inside a backpack could cause the ESC key to not work on the first try.
[*] Fixed a bug where Wraith would not chase the player.
[*] Fixed a case where the Birdman and Prodigal Daughter could shoot the player without aiming.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Chaos Die could be “consumed” when using a controller or keyboard shortcut.
[*] Fireweed in Chapter 2 will always be picked up without checking for space in the player’s inventory.

notes.title: 3.0.4 Update + Trading Cards are here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Howdy Gunslingers,[/h1]

The promised update has arrived and it is ready to go, but before you go digging into the newest changes, let us share with you one more thing that will make some of you happy.
[h2]Steam Community items[/h2]
As of today, Steam Community items have been enabled for [b]Blood West[/b], so expect some trading cards to drop while you play. There are also badges to unlock, forum emotes, profile bacxkgrounds - the whole shabang! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/ebb9ebc0fe12d20f2f76e40ff490348db81673c1.png[/img]

Keep an eye out for these sweet special Steam item drops, and now back to the 3.0.4 update. It's time to give you the...

[h2]Full 3.0.4 changelog[/h2]
[h3]Major Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a very rare error that occurred when accessing the player’s stash that results in items being lost
[*] Fixed a very rare instance of items being lost - after the patch is applied, the lost items should be back in player’s inventory
[*] Fixed inability to save & exit the game via pause menu for some players
[*] Fixed issue where removing Occult Mask without full HP didn’t remove the effect
[*] Second level of Gunslinger perk no longer affects bosses
[*] Fixed rare crash that occurred on opening bags in a trading window
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause some players to not be able to pick up items from the ground
[*] Way of the Spirit is no longer tradeable
[/list]

[h3]Minor Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that made builds using Devil’s Eye to increase player’s HP beyond the intended levels
[*] Disabled mouse acceleration/smoothing that was not suppose to be active
[*] Fixed an issue where the  Emerald Eyes could be taken off without dying or using Purple Revival
[*] Animated Dead will no longer perform two charges/jumps in a row
[*] Certain artifacts and weapons were not working correctly - including Giant Leech, Drunken Master, Corrupted Liver
[*] Fixed an exploit that allowed player not tot pay for partial stacks of items under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed a case where the  number of available charges of Whetstone disappeared from HUD
[*] Revolvers are better aligned towards the center
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the cursor to disappear when the player left the trading window in a specific manner
[*] Spite no longer will kill player if they have exactly 5 HP remaining when trying to shoot
[*] Lionheart should now work correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where the [spoiler]friendly Boo Hag[/spoiler] could be both at the old and new camp
[*] Blowing up enemies heads with dynamite no longer counts towards the Headhunter achievement
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the  player was not able to move after teleporting back to the Safe Zone
[*] Bunch of smaller typos and improvements to translations
[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Undead Hunters take aim faster, making them more dangerous
[*] Scallywag now prioritizes throwing molotov at player over using a shotgun
[*] Increased the range of the stomp attack for boss of Chapter 2 
[*] Crimson Brooch found on maps will have non-default price values
[*] The following perks have been slightly rebalanced: Bloodless, High Tolerance, Gotcha, Bloody Carnage, Pitcher, Strong Lungs, Alive and Dangerous, Self-taught and Gunslinger
[/list]

[h3]Other improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to change keybind for item rotation on the inventory screen
[*] Added an the option to hide/show UI as desired, using a bindable key
[*] Added the ability to limit fps to a desired value
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Negative Stamina regeneration (until death, or next strong melee attack) 
[*] Whetstone buff icon may remain on screen and as an effect after all charges has been used
[*] Enemies may stop moving under certain rare circumstances
[*] Rare case when one of the NPC doesn’t update correctly and softlocks player when trying to talk to them
[*] There were reported crashes on Chapter 3 for some players
[/list]

[h2]See you on the trail Gunslingers![/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/837feb3f28a9199565f25131081dd9a6a06b4fa0.png[/img]

notes.title: Blood West 3.0.3 Hotfix - missing skill points reinstated!
notes.notes:
Howdy!

In the release version of [b]Blood West[/b] we've done a reset of the skill point allocations, so players returning to the game can re-distribute them in the redesigned skill-tree. In some rare cases this caused the perks to reset alright, but didn't grant any skill points to distribute. This hotfix alleviates this problem, and addresses some other issues. Full changelog follows:

[h2]Minor:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Long Jack no longer reduces maximum HP of the player on debuff
[*] Alvaro’s Necklace has been slightly buffed
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause players continuing game from previous specific version of the game to not have their perks/levels reset properly
[*] Protagonist moans were too loud, we calmed him down a bit
[*] Emerald Eyes could still provide better prices at shops without being equipped
[*] Specific rope in Chapter 3 was trying to kill players - now it should behave properly
[*] Fixed a bug regarding a full stack of 5 Hellbear Hearts
[*] Fixed a bug with Devil’s Eye constantly giving more HP than it should, after save & load
[/list]

[h3]Good hunting, Gunslingers![/h3]
[h2]Hyperstrange[/h2]

notes.title: Full Version of Blood West and Chapter 3 is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Howdy Gunslingers,[/h1]

[b]Today is the day folks, after months of development we are ready to share the final version of Blood West with you and the rest of the world.[/b] This has been a hell of a journey and we wouldn't have made it without your support during the Early Access. Your feedback and ideas kept our creative cogs running and made Chapter 3 and the final version of Blood West what it is today.

With all that out of the way, let's celebrate the launch not only with a [b]30% discount[/b], but also with a [b]brand new trailer![/b]

[h1]Blood West Launch Trailer[/h1]

[previewyoutube=mlX_2ch4K1c;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Even though this is the end of Early access, it is not the end of our support for Blood West.[/b] We have had a blast working on the title and you can expect more to come in the not so distant future. However, that is a story for another time. [b]Now it’s time to sling lead and throw witty one-liners - and we have both in ample supply.[/b]

[h1] 3.0.2 Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Major:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Official release of Chapter
[*] Improved gamepad controls
[*] New map - The Mountains
[*] New enemies, new weapons and artifacts
[*] Achievements
[/list]
[h2]Minor:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Addition of the Lock icon -  A visual representation that is displayed on items that can’t be unequipped at the current time (they are being used, they have certain requirements etc.)
[*] The Undead found a guitar during his scavenging trips to the Mountains. What use could he have for that?
[*] The message about the player lacking a map for the current region is now displayed every time it’s needed (previously it was displayed only once)
[*] Increased range for the Sensitivity option in Settings menu
[*] Performed lots of additional audio work across the whole game
[*] Updated Hungarian translation - including Chapter 3
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause players not being able to leave the Settings menu
[*] Fixed issues that resulted in not displaying proper button icons depending on the current input from the player
[*] Fixed issues that caused NPCs to t-pose under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed issue with the Undead that could make him spawn with his back towards the player
[*] Fixed an issue that could result in disappearing of an artifact from active inventory items when replacing it with other artifact
[*] Fixed an issue that could block tooltips from displaying properly 
[*] Fixed an issue where icons for numeric keypad buttons were not displayed correctly
[*] Perforated Heart now applies bleeding at correct Stamina value
[*] Depths of Tahoe now heals by correct value
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to put a backpack inside itself, causing the game to crash
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause delivered quest items in Chapter 2 to be invisible after loading the game
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to deal damage from heavy attack using animation for a normal attack
[*] Fixed some typos 
[/list]


[h1]See you in the Barren Lands,[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/837feb3f28a9199565f25131081dd9a6a06b4fa0.png[/img]

[h2]PS. Known issue:[/h2]
[b][i]If you haven't played Blood West for a while, you'll be returning to find the skill system re-designed. Your character's progress has been reset, and you should have all the skill points returned to you to distribute in the new skill tree. In some RARE CASES you will NOT GET your skill points back. If this affects you, please contact us at bugs@hyperstrange.com, and provide your safe file so we can fix it. A hotfix that will eliminate this issue entirely is already underway. We're sorry for the inconvenience, if you are one of the [strike]cursed[/strike] unlucky few.[/i][/b]

notes.title: Exciting news + Final Early Access maintenance update
notes.notes:
[h1]Howdy Gunslingers,[/h1]

[h3]With today’s update we are not only bringing you a plethora of changes but not one but TWO surprises. Grab your best cowboy hat and giddy up, it is time to get HYPED![/h3]

[h1]Blood West meets Ghoultown[/h1]
[previewyoutube=HBPPBh_MPac;full][/previewyoutube]

Yup, your peepers ain’t decivinn’ ya, the horror punk band [b]Ghoultown[/b] will be performing a brand new song, written specially for Blood West. But that ain’t all, we also have a brand new animation for this kick-ass occasion and [b]on the 20th of November everything will come together for the very first [url=https://youtu.be/GwehAAjKNWk]Blood West Animated Music Video![/url][/b]

[h3][url=https://youtu.be/GwehAAjKNWk]Get it on the fun today and sign-up to save your place on the digital stands![/url][/h3]


[h1]Blood West Bestiary[/h1]
[previewyoutube=UeFNcyztp4g;full][/previewyoutube]

Now for the second surprise. Can’t get enough of Blood West’s lore? Then keep your eye out for the new Blood West Bestiary series that will be dropping on our social media channels! Today you can hear what a certain someone, whom you have already “met” in the game has to say about the Hellbear. 

[h3]Follow and subscribe so as not to miss future episodes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Hyperstrange/featured]Youtube[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/5fCZK562jT]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/HYPERSTRANGE?]X (Twitter)[/url]
[/list]

[h1]2.4.0 Update[/h1]

Last but not least, we have the aforementioned 2.4.0 update. It is a lengthy one, so better grab something to drink.


[h3]Major:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Revamped perk system[/b] - overhauled the whole perk tree, introduced new perks, merged others and in general gave players more freedom to express their builds in more detailed ways. 
[*] When loading an old save on this version of the game, character points and level will be reset and player will be given the correct amount of points to re-distribute 
[*] Major balance pass to everything, from enemies to items, perks and more
[*] [b]New Voice Over for our undead gunslinger from Stephen Russell himself[/b]!
[*] Big optimization task has been completed and players should see an increase in fps across the board
[*] Improvements to how enemies hear the player. No more jumping assassins flying towards their prey without a sound! Shooting near a building is now a risk of angering a whole lot of trouble inside. 
[*] Added beds to Chapter 1 to keep it consistent with other maps and to add more options for the players regarding fast traveling (Chicken Heads are still needed, so look out for those!)
[*] Chapter 1 boss - alternative route is now connected to the actual fight. The way players go about that route will influence how hard the fight will be. Or you know, you could still go straight to the arena if you feel tough. 
[*] Boss fight of Chapter 2 has been improved and should pose more of a challenge
[*] [b]You asked for it. You got it: autosort button is available in inventory.[/b] 
[*] [b]Fanning for revolvers - a proper gunslinger’s best friend is here.[/b] 
[/list]

[h3]Other changes, improvements and additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]A new potion has been introduced that allows respec of player’s character.[/b]
[*] [b]Previously known areas may be a bit different… (Chapter 1 mostly)[/b]
[*] [b]Enemy placement and balance across the board has been improved[/b]
[*] New option for setting up the frequency of our beloved protagonist’s barks - you wouldn’t dare to turn those off, would you?
[*] LOTS of language improvements, corrected typos and other gremlins
[*] VO for Jim Hooper has been changed
[*] Mouse wheel and space are now correctly bindable as player wishes
[*] Magpie buff from Totem of Souls has been nerfed
[*] Improved the in-game compass - now it shows the world directions like a good compass should
[*][b] Ammunition from bags is now usable by the player - reload away![/b] No more having to open inventory, find your bag and unpack those damn bullets manually each time you wanted to reload. 
[*] Player character will lower his weapon when talking to NPCs. A bit of good manners.
[*] Lots of general audio improvements
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A number of possible crashes has been addressed
[*] At very specific circumstances, NPCs from Chapter 2 would not act according to their story route
[*] Bunch of quality of life improvements across the board ie. how double clicking to move items works in certain scenarios
[*] Fixed a case when it was possible to miss an attack when using a knife and sneaking behind an enemy
[*] Tomahawk can no longer crash the game when thrown at lamp
[*] You will no longer respawn in wrong camp in 3rd Chapter after certain story threshold

notes.title: BLOOD WEST Chapter 2 - 2.3 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Gunslingers![/h1]

Today it will get a bit crowded in the changelog, but for the better of course. Some long awaited changes and updates are here, along with some minor fixes.

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] General gameplay optimization - Through the power of science and a bit of magic you can expect a 20-30 FPS boost on most machines.

[*] New Decal system - Previously blood spurts and splatters had a tendency to ignore laws of physics and geometry. Now they should adhere to nature’s laws. Additionally, we have increased the minimum time before blood splats disappear from 7 to 15 seconds.

[*] Reduced Loading times - This small series of fixes should reduce loading time by 70% (depending on the CPU of course). 

[*] Backup saves - The game will now keep backups of 3 last saves. Save will be performed additionally on each player death and during resting.

[*] UI changes - Inventory will now state that double clicking on an item will result in selling / purchasing said item. This feature was already there, but we have decided to add a tooltip, so as to avoid troublesome situations. 

[*] Winchester is now a Lever Rifle - God bless trademarks…

[*] Consistency updates - Items will now have the same color of name in the inventory and on tooltip while picking them up from ground also when traveling from chapter 1 to chapter 2 the stash will keep position / orientation of items stored there.

[*] Lip animations - [spoiler] Annabelle will now have proper lip animation when talking (after her mask has fallen off) [/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]Balancing: [/h2]

[list]
[*] Only one today - We have tweaked the stamina cost of melee weapons.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes: [/h2]

[list]
[*] Skin Collector will flee from the player when beyond reach or when the monster has no more heads to be thrown.
[*] Sometimes Rougarou failed to start to  consume corpses.
[*] Golden ammo could be incorrectly applied to other weapons, when saving and reloading game.
[*] Purple Revival unlock feature will now persist after saving and reloading game.
[*] Fixed problem with Looter perk and picking up Molotov's from Scallywags.
[*] Sometimes additional perks for Chapter 2 were not unlocked correctly.
[*] Teleporting with Raven Skull will no longer apply falling damage.
[*] Golden bolt and Keen bolt were not applying bonus damage to the crossbow.
[*] Huge bags couldn't be opened while trading.
[*] Fixed some typos in English dialogues.
[*] Added missing audio for ignited dynamite after being thrown.
[*] Fixed mis-animation on trigger of the Buffalo Rifle and on string of the Crossbow.
[*] It is now impossible to kill Chapter 1 boss by throwing dynamite to the large open cave behind Fort.
[*] Fixed Vendigo pathing near the roots of Chapter 1 boss.
[*] Fixed sound volume prefix being played after leaving the sound volume menu while in-game.

notes.title: Blood West - Chapter 2, Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
[h1]Gunslingers![/h1]

We are loading the chamber with another round of quick fixes. These should keep these pesky bugs at bay. 

[h3][b]Changelog:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred when fighting leeches in cultist caves.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when dynamite was about to explode in the player's hand.
[*] Fixed a potential crash that could occur when dying right before firing a projectile into an enemy.
[*] There is a new, separate tab for quest artifacts. They will no longer obstruct the inventory.
[*] Angel’s Halo is no longer sellable (the player could get locked out from the main quest by selling all available items on the map).
[*] Soul Flaws and Curses will no longer transfer between the maps.
[*] All item tooltips will now correctly state effects when effects depend on a modifier or other condition (for example Blood Bow will now calculate the damage increase correctly).
[*] Swamps Boss no longer spawns tentacles in the same spot twice.
[*] Detection Meter no longer freezes if the player remains on a ladder.
[*] Resolved an issue where some enemies could be heard even when muting audio.
[*] There is a round of new character perks available on the Swamps map.
[*] Fixed an issue where weapons could be lost when switching them right after the Canyons Boss is killed.
[*] Quest tooltips on the Swamps map now correctly wrap words.
[*] Descriptions of Owl’s Shadow and Long Jack now correctly state the duration of the effects.
[*] Deleting a save now requires confirmation.
[*] Added a backup system for saves (auto-saving during rest or after death, preserving the last three states in case a save gets corrupted).
[*] Fixed instances where Spirits didn’t deal 200% damage when Glove of Wyrdness was equipped.
[*] Resolved an issue where Giant Leech did not reduce damage taken from bleeding.
[*] Rougarou will now correctly ignore the player if Rougarou’s Tongue is equipped, even if the player engages non-Rougarou mobs.
[*] Alvaro’s Rib did not state how much Stamina it gives, now it does.
[*] Solved an issue where Corrupted Liver incorrectly gave a permanent bonus of +40 health and stamina.
[*] Death Stalkers summoned by Music Box no longer keep respawning on each loaded save.
[*] Scallywags’ Molotov now disappears from the model if it is not available in their inventory. The Scallywags’ Molotov supply for throwing is still infinite.
[*] Soul Catcher description will now correctly state how much stamina it gives.
[*] Angel’s Halo can now be stored in bags.
[*] Under some circumstances it was possible to obtain more than one blessing on Swamps.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Buffalo Rifle did not allow the player to change the ammo type after shooting.
[*] Some mouse sensitivity settings will no longer be lost after death.
[*] Yellow River will now correctly state the effect’s duration.
[*] Resolved an issue where under some circumstances, it was not possible to unequip Perforated Heart.
[*] Resolved an issue where Sack of Money got stuck in inventory.
[*] Tutorial messages will no longer trigger second time on Swamps.
[*] Death Stalker head parts use correct meshes now.
[*] Wrong notification message was displayed if the player tried to remove Corrupted Liver while drunk.
[*] NPC Idle animations will no longer be interrupted if there is no good reason for that (like talking with the player).
[*] Corrected some typos in the UI.
[/list]

[h3]That is all for today's update. Stay safe and warm, partners![/h3]

notes.title: Blood West: Chapter 2 update is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Gunslingers![/h1]

On the 10th of February, Blood West moseyed on down to Steam Early Access. Since then, the posse of the revenant gunslinger only has grown. Currently, folks on Steam have given the game a ratin’ of 91% of positive reviews out of more than a thousand of them. The only complaint was that there ain’t enough of it… 

Tonight, on the last night of October, 2022, the dead once more come crawlin’ back from der’ graves to feast on the living with the horrifically huge update to [b]Blood West[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/f9daf6f885b8228262740e4e78490e17c6ad223c.png[/img]

This time players will have to test their grit against the swamps and their lovecraftian denizens. The new location itself is almost twice the size of the original Canyons. The new area is filled to the brim with points of interest, from old fishing towns and alligator farms to a derelict paddle steamer.

The players will also have a chance to run into an old friend as well as meet new fully voice-acted dudes and dudettes who will tell you a tale or two. Tho’ this ain’t gonna be a sightseein’ trip as cultists of cosmic horrors, zombie alligators, specters, and all other nasty varmints will be huntin’ you in these desolate lands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/334a4c96d58d0e9224789acc5b4abe9ea5c10d28.png[/img]

As in Chapter 1, it’s better to come prepared. New artifacts, potions, and weapons can be found on the swamps or purchased from those who are still breathin’. There’s even a crossbow for those who are feelin’ medieval.

To sweeten the deal, as a part of Steam Scream Sale, [b]Blood West[/b] will be available at a 25% discount till the 1st of November, till 18.00 CEST. We have even thrown in a fistful of bug fixes and optimizations for Chapter 1. That's only 24 more hours, so don't waste any time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West

Please note, that this is an Early Access update and the game is still in WIP state. There are some things still amiss in this update, and we'll be rolling out subsequent patches as they come (please refer to the release notes below), but we really wanted to make your Halloween special, rather than wait until everything is perfect!

[h2]Release notes:[/h2]
[b]New content, features and improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Whole new map!
[*] Bigger than Canyons! (1.5x larger, and more tightly-packed with content)
[*] 9 new enemies
[*] 5 new NPCs and 1 old friend
[*] 5 new types of weapons
[*] 11 new unique weapons
[*] 25 new artefacts
[*] 3 new potions
[*] More than twice as many dialogues
[*] General optimization, including the Canyons
[*] A whole lotta bug fixes
[/list]
[b]Known issues and WIP things:[/b]
[list]
[*] no DE and RU language versions yet (they're on the way - ETA November 14)
[*] some SFX are not final
[*] optimization is not yet final
[/list]
[b]Legacy bugs, fixed with this update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Birdmans were shooting rapidly when pinned against wall
[*] Potion can wrongly stay in inventory after use if animation didn't finish
[*] Burning sfx from Molotov can stay even after respawn if player died/reloaded
[*] It is possible to die with equiped Gold Coin and still get Soul Flaw
[*] Key Item sfx can be heard through the floor
[*] AI reacts for Molotov sounds
[*] Revolver animation glitching when zooming out and reloading
[*] Equip animation is skip-able if player holds LMB
[*] Fire from destroyed lantern can destroy objects below the floor
[*] Humanpede can spit on the celling, and player standing on it can get damage from accid
[*] Shaman totem has too short range in binding
[*] Boss life and wooden platforms renew after a failed fight.
[*] Slider for overfowing intentory won't show up without forcing a refresh on container's items
[*] Boss could be killed from above by throwing molotovs into it
[*] Removing curse with Purple Revival doesnt cancel the totem quest
[*] Enemy from sneaking tutorial won't react if he is triggered during his walk back to original spot
[*] Player can get stuck behind Totem and a rock at the Shaman's cave
[/list]
[h3]Good fortune, partners![/h3]

notes.title: Blood West: Chapter 2 update is coming on October 31! + Halloween promo!
notes.notes:
[h1]Gunslingers![/h1]

This is the Season of the Dead... and Undead! Something sinister is brewing once again in the Barren Lands. Some of you may already have freed the deserted mining town of the demonic presence brought about by unspeakable deeds. But there is no rest for the wicked! You'll be summoned again, to face an even greater evil in a place even more twisted and creepy. [b]Blood West: Chapter 2 update[/b] arrives on October 31!

[previewyoutube=ll6tFR5ebg4;full][/previewyoutube]

So, if you haven't played [b]Blood West[/b] yet, this [b]Steam Scream Fest[/b] is a great excuse to pick it up 25% OFF...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West/

...and get into the game just before it gets BIGGER. "How much BIGGER is Blood West gettin, Hyperstrange?". Glad you've asked!

[h2]What to expect from Chapter[/h2]

A bit of background, first. When [b]Blood West[/b] launched into Early Access in February, we knew we had something special, but we were still blown away by the exceptional reception of our wild west / horror stealth shooter. You folks loved it. It was the first ever Hyperstrange title to enjoy the Overwhelmingly Positive review score - and for quite a long time, for that matter.

But for all the love [b]Blood West[/b] received here, it was conceived as a side project. A smaller-scale game, that could've been developed by a smaller team alongside our smash-hit, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/url]. We've announced an Early Access roadmap that would have us releasing the second chapter in the summer, and wrapping up the project around November. A small-scale game, by a small-scale team. Seeing the audience's reaction we knew, this wouldn't be the best way to go anymore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/1c1e59d0c78ca5f24c029339f2fa670a53959e8a.png[/img]

The team working on [b]Blood West[/b] was expanded, and the gears shifted towards making the project a bit more ambitious. A single-player, cozy experience nonetheless, but with a bit more of... everything, than originally planned. So - back on topic - what you can expect of Chapter 2? 
[list]
[*] A new map that's not only larger, but more tightly packed with events and points of interest. 
[*] New weapons and items, including artifacts and unique guns. 
[*] More NPCs with more elaborate quest lines and at least four times as much dialog lines. 
[*] Brand-new monsters swarming the - much more detailed - new environment: the swamp. 
[*] Brand new mysteries to piece together while learning more about the Barren Lands and the nature of Evil. 
[/list]
All this and more to provide a proper challenge to the buffed-up, armed-to-the-teeth desperados who already completed chapter one. All of it coming your way in just a few days!

[h3]Good fortune, Gunslingers![/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/c1f52137ea22596c7a9f0d203855c812c4a283db.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/2bc33f7d62aa815b11a170c06fa81c77c83e5bc5.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Blood West 1.1 update
notes.notes:
[h2]Gunslingers![/h2]

You've been fighting relentlessly to take back the frontier from the bloody claws of otherworldly abominations for two full months. And there's thousands of you! We've been blown away by your enthusiastic reception of [b]Blood West[/b] and humbled by the [b]overwhelmingly positive reviews[/b]. You've been recommending our game to your friends and other Steam players, and it means the world to us. We know we love old-school, immersive gameplay full of stealth, tactics, and exploration - it's nice to know you do, too!
[code][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/c2bd5a54ba809f84f985a2c640692eca45d64732.png[/img]
The Skin Collector - enemy concept in the upcoming scenario[/code]

Some of you say our western stealth shooter arrived in Early Access in better form than some high-profile games left it. That's a bar set really high, for sure, and we're doing and will continue to do our best to meet your expectations. We don't yet have a set release date for the upcoming content update that will bring about the second playable scenario. Seeing how much you appreciate the fine details of our creation we want to put as much - or more - effort into crafting the next rich and varied part of the world of [b]Blood West[/b]. 
[code][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/35fe12b252288396b3d09a3981c14d22b5b8cf11.png[/img]
The Wraith - enemy concept in the upcoming scenario[/code]

While we work on the new content we also improve on some aspects of the existing game, because there's always room for improvement, and we're no strangers to early access. Today marks the release of our first regular Early Access update (full changelog below!). It'll be accompanied by a week-long promo matching the release discount of 20%, so all of you who were on the fence with Blood West in the release week and held out until there's more reviews - here's your chance!

[h2]Full 1.1 changelog:[/h2]

Following your generous feedback and going through the many gameplay videos and streams, we've decided our priorities for the first post-release patch. Here's how we're improving on the game's mechanics and introducing some quality-of-life improvements:

[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list][*]A new, alternate bossfight path
[*]Leaning from behind cover (make sure to bind the keys!)
[*]New vendor items - sacks that improve inventory management
[*]By popular demand items in the inventory can now be rotated to improve stackability (have fun!)
[*]You can now bind the key to unload ammo
[*]FOV slider added
[*]V-Sync toggle added
[*]Brightness / gamma setting (does not affect the UI)
[*]ESC key closes inventory/map screen
[*]Trying to bind a key that's already in use will prompt an option to swap them
[*]Keybind menu cannot be closed if not all keys have been set, missing bindings will be highlighted[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list][*]Improved enemy A.I. - they will react to gunshots in their hearing range, notice if another mob in their line of sight is killed, become alarmed in vicinity of other aggravated mobs
[*]Jim's lucky coin quest is now failable if the player chooses to keep the coin for themselves
[*]Reworked the acid-spitting Humanpede behavior - it should now be more challenging to fight, although it still prefers to avoid up-close combat
[*]Nerfed the Collector perk - it generates less loot
[*]Nerfed the Gotcha! perk - it now provides just longer, not infinite effective headshot distance
[*]Totem blessings no longer stack - you can only have one active at a time
[*]Putting a bow on the ground while it was drawn will return the arrow to the inventory
[*]Removed the Shadow Heart item
[*]Reduced healing items and ammo amount player can find in the game world
[*]Some spelling and grammar corrections (not final)[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list][*]Loading your game no longer causes FPS to drop
[*]Quitting the game by Alt+F4 combo no longer risks corrupting your save file
[*]The UI prompts display the correct bindings right away, not after game restart as it used to
[*]Ctrl and Shift keys are now bindable
[*]Reloading the boss fight no longer causes wendigo not to spawn properly
[*]Fixed the rare bug that allowed losing or multiplying bandages (and other stackable items)
[*]Fixed the breaking platform in the boss fight which was breaking to quick on subsequent tries
[*]Sliding or running downwards on slopes no longer generates damage to the player
[*]Multiple fixes to the save game functionality
[*]More clear option selection ("Accept" closes the form and saves the changes, "Back" was renamed to "Cancel", acts accordingly)
[*]Molotov burning sound no longer loops on mob impact
[*]Mobs no longer vocalize post-death (which occurred when killed with shotgun or other multi-projectile weapon)
[*]Ghosts no longer leave blood splatter on walls[/list]

Please note that after the patch loading an existing save game will result in the player being re-located to a safe zone, and all the monsters will be re-spawned.
